method: Read-only inspection of preserved raw responses, terminal metadata, correlation records, and the Mission 056 runner fallback implementation.

mission_056.fallback_mechanism: scripts/mission056_candidate_only_heal.py::_operation_id(payload, fallback) searches provider keys, then returns the supplied fallback. Its caller supplied the AEGIS operation ID as that fallback.
mission_056.conclusion: The retained provider_operation_id and provider_run_id are AEGIS-local fallback values, not observed Bright Data job/operation identifiers. They cannot be used as a provider-diagnostic key.

documentation_research_gate: NOT_ENTERED — Mission 058 requires an actual observed provider job/operation identifier before researching or invoking an identifier-keyed diagnostic.
